errors.error_description: Introduced a state-holding register clocked by a non-clock control signal using always_ff @(posedge capture), creating a flop without a proper clock edge.
Created an incomplete case statement for next_word generation missing a branch, causing latch inference during synthesis.
Added an extra enumerated FSM state that is never transitioned into, making it unreachable.
Used a deeply nested conditional operator chain to drive serial_out, leading to suboptimal combinational logic.
